column1: # Operations the signed-in ZAP pass leaves out, because running them ends the token, the session or the user.
# The anonymous pass still sends them without a token. Each line: method, tab, path exactly as in
# openapi/baseline.json, tab, reason. scripts/dast-spec-filter.py exits 2 for a line the spec does not
# have, and scripts/test-dast.sh fails when a route that calls a revocation function is in neither this
# file nor its list of routes a User-role token cannot reach.

column3: RevokeTokenAsync and RevokeAllUserTokensAsync: revokes the presented token and every token of the user
SessionRoutes.EndAsync ends the session named in the path, which is the current one when the id is its sid
RevokeRefreshTokens.ForUserAsync ends every session of the user when the password changes
RevokeTokenAsync revokes the presented token once the switch succeeds
RevokeRefreshTokens.ForUserAsync ends the sessions when MFA is enabled
RevokeRefreshTokens.ForUserAsync ends the sessions when MFA is disabled
